newsitem.title: USA: NEC introduces color ink jet printer.
newsitem.headline: NEC introduces color ink jet printer.

text.p: NEC Technologies, Inc. Monday introduced a low-cost colour ink jet printer for use with home computers.
The SuperScript 100C will sell for $129 after a $40 mail-in rebate through Jan. 31, 1997, the company said.
The compact 4.84 pound machine will produce both monochrome and colour printouts at about 3 pages per minute.
The printer, which is compatible with Windows 3.1, Windows 95 and DOS environments, will come with a disposable colour ink cartridge. A black ink cartridge will be sold separately.
The new machine will be available at retailers in September.
NEC Technologies, Inc. is a subsidiary of NEC Corporation, a manufacturer of computer peripherals and other technology products.
